response.sql: WITH color_totals AS (SELECT p.product_color, SUM(CAST(l.product_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS qty FROM Invoice_Line_Items l JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), stats AS (SELECT product_color, qty, 1.0 * qty / SUM(qty) OVER () AS share, AVG(1.0 * qty) OVER () AS avg_qty_all FROM color_totals) SELECT AVG(1.0 * qty) AS avg_quantity, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(qty - avg_qty_all) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM stats WHERE qty > avg_qty_all;

assumptions.assumption: Color is taken from Products via the invoice line item's own product_id. NULL colors form a single group (GROUP BY puts NULLs together).
product_quantity values are numeric strings that cast cleanly to integers. Unparseable values would count as 0.

The average per color is the mean of the per-color totals across all color groups, including the NULL group. Share is a color's total divided by the grand total. Both are computed as decimals, not rounded.
